entry.title: Noah Wyle Is PEOPLE’s 2026 Sexiest Man Alive: “Oh My Goodness” | PEOPLE

media:group.media:title: Noah Wyle Is PEOPLE’s 2026 Sexiest Man Alive: “Oh My Goodness” | PEOPLE
media:group.media:description:
Noah Wyle shares his disbelief at being named PEOPLE’s 2026 Sexiest Man Alive: “Not in a million years did I think that this would be an honor bestowed on me.” He reveals how his wife Sara helped convince him to embrace the title, joking that “she was very pleased that this [reflects] well on her taste.” Noah reflects on his early rise to fame with ‘ER,’ admitting he was “faking it really well” as his life changed almost overnight. Now, with ‘The Pitt’ bringing what he calls the “second lightning strike in my life,” he opens up about approaching success with more presence and composure, and why feeling comfortable in his own skin is still a work in progress.
The conversation also explores his marriage, the handmade gifts he created while courting Sara and how they’re making more time for date nights. Noah reveals why he considers himself the household’s “dish maven” and reflects on the moment becoming a father changed his priorities: “They handed my son to me, and I was like, ‘Now I get it. It’s not about me, it’s about you.’” From navigating fame to finding romance in small gestures, this candid interview offers a personal look at Noah’s life, the family he treasures and the second chapter of his career.

entry.title: Elle Fanning & Elizabeth Banks Interview Each Other | PEOPLE

media:group.media:title: Elle Fanning & Elizabeth Banks Interview Each Other | PEOPLE
media:group.media:description:
Elle Fanning and Elizabeth Banks sit down to interview each other and dive into the world of Effie Trinket, the unforgettable 'Hunger Games' character they now share. Elle reveals how fan casting helped her land the role and thanks the fans whose YouTube compilations helped her practice Effie’s signature voice and mannerisms. Elizabeth reflects on the improvised lines and Alexander McQueen looks that helped define her Effie, while Elle opens up about finding a younger, less polished version of the character — with Elizabeth telling her, “You nailed it.” From Elizabeth’s lessons behind the camera to what still makes Elle nervous on set, the pair swap stories about acting, the enduring quotability of 'The 40-Year-Old Virgin' and their shared admiration for Glenn Close. 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' opens in theaters November 20th.

entry.title: My Mom Died for 45 Minutes While I Was Giving Birth | PEOPLE

media:group.media:title: My Mom Died for 45 Minutes While I Was Giving Birth | PEOPLE
media:group.media:description:
Kathy Patten went to the hospital to be by her daughter Stacey Fifer’s side as she gave birth to her first child. Instead, doctors were soon fighting to save Kathy’s life after a heart attack left her clinically dead for 45 minutes. Kathy had no heartbeat, blood pressure or oxygen flowing to her brain as doctors performed CPR and delivered shocks in repeated efforts to restart her heart. Stacey had learned she was pregnant around the time her husband was diagnosed with cancer — and now feared losing her mother just as she was becoming one herself. “My husband is calling my family letting everybody know that my mom has passed away,” Stacey recalls. As resuscitation efforts continued, Dr. Dov Frankel urged Kathy to keep fighting: “You need to see your grandchild.”
In this powerful interview, Kathy opens up about her near-death experience (NDE), joining Stacey and Dr. Frankel to recount the desperate effort to save her life and the moment her heart regained a rhythm after doctors administered a clot-dissolving medication. Despite fears that she might have suffered brain damage, Kathy made a full recovery, allowing her to watch her granddaughter grow up and be there for Stacey after her husband passed away from cancer. Today, Kathy credits the granddaughter she had yet to meet as the guardian angel that helped bring her back: “She saved me.”
